Subject: Evidence & roadmap: log retention, deletion SLA, backups

Hi Maya — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and the items we agreed to follow up on related to data retention and deletion SLAs so your security/engineering teams can evaluate scope: 

1) Current state summary we promised to provide: SOC 2 status, HIPAA/GDPR posture, and a short retention matrix showing logs, backups, and deletion timelines.
2) Evidence you asked for: SOC 2 summary, example backup retention snapshots, and a one-page deletion workflow.
3) Next steps: I’ll share the retention matrix and SOC 2 summary by EOD today; Laura (cc) will pull a sample backup snapshot export and the deletion workflow.

Attachments: Security-Questionnaire_ClearHealth.docx (your submitted vendor questionnaire) — I’ll populate answers and return in my next message.

Do you want us to include a short architecture diagram showing where logs are persisted and how long they live per environment (prod vs staging)? If yes, I’ll add it to the matrix.

— Sergio

sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

From: Maya Patel <maya@clearhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearhealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & roadmap: log retention, deletion SLA, backups

Thanks, Sergio — this is helpful. A couple clarifying questions before we review the artifacts: 

- SOC 2: are you reporting Type II? If so, can you share the date range for the last attestation and a redacted report or AICPA letter?
- HIPAA/GDPR: is Redwood a HIPAA-covered entity or a BAA partner? We need to know whether PHI can be processed and what contractual language you provide. For GDPR we just need confirmation on data subject rights support (erasures, export).
- Logs vs backups: what is your default retention for (a) request/trace logs, (b) model input logs, and (c) backups/snapshots? 
- Deletion SLA: if a customer invokes deletion for an account, how long until data is removed from live systems, from backups, and what’s the certificate/evidence we can expect?

We attached our Security-Questionnaire version (sent earlier) — answered where obvious. Please complete the document and return with the supporting artifacts.

We’d also like a short timeline for when you can provide the artifacts (SOC doc redaction, retention matrix PDF, and an export sample). If possible, loop in your security or legal SME.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Patel | Sr. Security Program Manager, ClearHealth
maya@clearhealth.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & roadmap: log retention, deletion SLA, backups

Maya — quick answers inline, then artifacts attached.

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31. I’m attaching a redacted summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf). We can share an AICPA letter under NDA if needed.

- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood signs a BAA with customers who need PHI handling. We are not a covered entity; we operate as a service provider. I’ll flag Legal for a BAA template if you want to see contractual language.

- GDPR: We support data subject erasure and portability via our API and for hosted deployments we provide the tools + documented workflow. Deletion requests trigger the deletion workflow (details in the retention matrix).

- Retention defaults (hosted):
  * request/trace logs: 90 days default
  * model input logs (customer-configurable): 30 days default, configurable to 0 for opt-out
  * backups/snapshots: daily snapshots retained for 90 days; monthly snapshot archived for 12 months on request (longer-term archivals require contract add-on)

- Deletion SLA:
  * Live system removal: within 24 hours after validated request (logical deletion and unlinking from indices)
  * Backups: standard backup retention window applies; certified purge from backups within 30 days after the deletion request is scheduled (we provide a certificate of deletion for the account once complete)
  * Evidence: we can provide a deletion certificate plus an export of the purge operation record (ticket + timestamp). Full forensic logs can be provided under an agreed engagement.

Attached: Retention-Matrix-v1.pdf (matrix + brief diagrams), redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf, my completed Security-Questionnaire_ClearHealth.docx (answers populated).

Proposed timing: we’ll send the artifacts now (attached). If you want the AICPA letter or BAA template, Laura can coordinate — Laura, can you own the BAA template and a sample backup export for Maya?

— Sergio
From: Maya Patel <maya@clearhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearhealth.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & roadmap: log retention, deletion SLA, backups

Sergio/Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround and the documents. A couple quick asks before we escalate to procurement: 

- Please send the BAA template and a short note from your legal confirming Redwood’s responsibilities for BAA-covered processing.
- We’d like a redacted sample backup export (metadata only) that shows timestamps and retention tags; Laura — appreciate you owning that.
- For the deletion certificate: can you include the exact fields you will show on the certificate (request id, account id, timestamp of purge, operator id)? That will speed our procurement checklist.

Next step: can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with Laura and your security lead next week? Options: Mon 23rd 10–11am PT or Tue 24th 3–4pm PT.

If that works, we’ll place this with Procurement for a fast review once the BAA + backup sample are in.

Appreciate it — Maya
